question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Cat's pajamas
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e. "Excellent and Outstanding".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Cat's pajamas"** refers to something that is excellent, outstanding, or the best in its category. (अत्युत्तम)

 
 
• **Example:** The new smartphone is really the cat's pajamas; it has all the latest features.
 
 
 
• **"Excellent and Outstanding"** refers to something of exceptional quality or performance. (उत्कृष्ट और असाधारण)
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance in the competition was excellent and outstanding; she truly deserved the trophy.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "Cat's pajamas" means "Excellent and Outstanding".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Boring and repetitive** (उबाऊ और दोहरावपूर्ण): Something that lacks excitement or variety and is monotonous.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was boring and repetitive; I struggled to stay awake.
 
 
 
• **Soft and soothing** (मुलायम और सुखदायक): Something that has a calming or comforting effect.
 
 
• **Example:** The music was soft and soothing, perfect for relaxation.
 
 
 
• **Frightening and dubious** (डरावना और संदिग्ध): Something that causes fear or seems suspicious.
 
 
• **Example:** The old abandoned house looked frightening and dubious at night.
